meta.title: 三开间前廊前院虚拟民居
meta.scope: 单栋认识与粗粒度关系表达；前院为关联空间
meta.representativeness: 借鉴台州等江浙民居常见构成的人工组合，不是复原实物、地域典型性证明或畲族研究发现
meta.inferenceBoundary: 推演结果另存；不自动覆盖事实标签与属性
meta.coordinateSystem: 局部米制：X东、Y北、Z上；地坪Z=0；建筑南侧Y=0
meta.dataSource: 全部实例、尺寸、材料和用途为本次合成设定；文献仅支持方法与构成参照
meta.formatNote: 本文件为候选语义模型与几何交换数据，不是已执行的Neo4j数据库快照。

materialLabels.材质_木: 对象或该系统含木材；不表达材种与体积比例
materialLabels.材质_砖: 合成设定为砖质主体；真实对象须有材料依据
materialLabels.材质_灰泥: 含灰泥饰面；不自动等于墙芯材料
materialLabels.材质_陶瓦: 含陶质屋面瓦；不表达瓦片数量

relationVocabulary.definition: 一个构件或空间属于本案例定义的整体；不表示类型上位，也不自动表示接触。
前院服务于该主屋；保留独立空间身份，不并入建筑本体面积。
墙体的部分表面界定该空间；墙上存在门窗时由界面另行记录，不表示整墙可穿行。

分界／开口对应的实体构件；无实体分界时可以没有这条边。

relationVocabulary.definition: 使用相同坐标系，按明确参照点/轴给出相对位置。方位角与两轴夹角分别记录。

drawingContract.geometryScope: 示意构造，无梁架/节点详图；渲染墙实体必须避让开口
scopeNotes: 所有图从同一JSON参数生成；仅供语义与几何一致性讨论，不是施工图。
南北立面展示主屋，前院围墙省略。
平面北向向上；各立面标明视向；A—A切面X=4.8m。
I04宽度是跨越柱列的分界线跨度，不是连续净宽。

researchReferences.supports: 材料环境、构造系统、空间形制及一字型单体等分析参照
researchReferences.does_not_support: 本案例具体平面、尺寸、材料、用途、结构安全或地域代表性

modelBoundary.spaceGeometry: 仅有平面区域及地坪标高，没有宣称封闭、无缝的三维空间实体。门洞沿墙中心线记录；与房间净边界之间有墙厚，不能直接拿平面线条相触判定通行。
modelBoundary.interfaceScope: 优先记录门窗和开放过渡；普通实体边界用BOUNDED_BY，不把每一块墙面都节点化。I08—I10北窗的室外端暂不实例化，不能据此生成完整室外图。
modelBoundary.materialAnalysis: 材料标签统一字典；同一对象可多标签。计数须先限定对象类别和层级，含某材料不等于面积、体积或质量比例。
modelBoundary.neo4jMapping: JSON为交换与展示结构；geometry、labelEvidence、properties中的嵌套对象须另作LPG存储映射，尚未导入数据库。
modelBoundary.completeness: 只对本轮墙柱屋顶、空间、开口与基础量测任务提供可互核资料；梁架、榫卯、厨房与生活设施未展开，不能称完整实物复原。

methodSources.title: Building Topology Ontology (BOT) specification
methodSources.claim: 区分空间、实体构件与界面；界面用于限定对象间关系；几何可关联外部表示。
methodSources.read_scope: 定向阅读上述定义与例子，2026-10-24。
methodSources.can_support: 本案例对空间、构件和界面的语义区分。
methodSources.cannot_support: 本案LPG关系名、通行规则和虚拟建筑事实由本研究另行定义，不宣称完整BOT实现。

methodSources.title: The Shapely User Manual
methodSources.locator: Geometric objects and coordinate systems; General Attributes and Methods (area, length, distance); predicates intersects, touches, within.
methodSources.claim: For coordinate-defined planar geometries, Shapely provides deterministic area, length, distance, and topological predicates. It explicitly performs analysis in the x-y plane and ignores z.
methodSources.read_scope: Read the coordinate-system and geometry notes, measurement methods, and topological-predicate sections; not the full manual.
methodSources.can_support: After plan lines, room polygons, openings, and a scale-aware coordinate system have been traced, calculate 2D lengths/areas/distances and candidate contains/intersects/touches relations reproducibly.
methodSources.cannot_support: It does not extract or semantically recognize a drawing, establish that traced coordinates match a real building, or calculate roof slope from z; z is ignored in its geometric analysis.

methodSources.title: Navigation-Oriented Topological Model Construction Algorithm for Complex Indoor Space
methodSources.locator: Sections 3.2 (space-wall and room-room topology), 4.3 (polygon extraction), 4.5 (complexity), 5.1-5.3 (tests), and conclusion.
methodSources.claim: The paper constructs room polygons and adjacency/connectivity/inclusion relations from building-plan linework using graph and disjoint-set methods, and reports tests on real and simulated plans. Its conclusion says semantic extraction from plan annotations is outside the method's current treatment.
methodSources.read_scope: Read indexed full-text excerpts for the specified methods, tests, and conclusion. The publisher page was throttled, so this was not a full-paper read.
methodSources.can_support: A plan-derived topology baseline for room boundaries, wall incidence, adjacency, and connectivity, once linework is available.
methodSources.cannot_support: Automatic interpretation of untraced drawings, reliable semantic/material classification without annotation, or transfer of the reported algorithm's validity to Jingning dwellings.

methodSources.title: Neo4j Cypher Manual (current)
methodSources.locator: Patterns and path matching: https://neo4j.com/docs/cypher-manual/current/patterns/ ; aggregating functions: https://neo4j.com/docs/cypher-manual/25/functions/aggregating/ ; spatial values and functions: https://neo4j.com/docs/cypher-manual/current/values-and-types/spatial/ and https://neo4j.com/docs/cypher-manual/current/functions/spatial/ .
methodSources.claim: Cypher MATCH expresses graph-pattern and path queries; count/avg/sum aggregate matched values; built-in spatial geometry is POINT (2D or 3D), with point distance requiring compatible CRS and dimensions. Spatial functions specify points and calculate point-to-point distance.
methodSources.read_scope: Read current pattern, spatial-value, and spatial-function pages; the official aggregation page was reviewed via its indexed excerpt for grouping and aggregate functions, not fully opened.
methodSources.can_support: Run graph rules, fixed/variable-length path queries, relationship integrity checks, and grouped counts/statistics; store coordinates/derived quantities and compute supported point-to-point distances.
methodSources.cannot_support: Without custom functions or a separate geometry engine, Cypher is not a drawing interpreter or general wall/polygon/solid geometry engine; graph paths alone do not calculate polygon area, shared-boundary length, or roof slope.

methodSources.title: KICGPT: Large Language Model with Knowledge in Context for Knowledge Graph Completion
methodSources.locator: Sections 1 and 3.1-3.3 define link prediction and candidate ranking; sections 4.1-4.2 describe benchmark data and MRR/Hits metrics; conclusion and limitations.
methodSources.claim: The paper treats completion as predicting and ranking a missing entity in an incomplete triple, combining a KG retriever with LLM re-ranking and demonstrations. It evaluates against held-out benchmark triples; this is predictive evaluation, not evidence verification for a particular building.
methodSources.read_scope: Read the abstract, problem definition, method, benchmark setup, metrics/results, and limitations; not a broader KGC survey.
methodSources.can_support: Use an LLM to propose/rank missing relation or label candidates, and evaluate predictions against deliberately hidden known triples in a controlled graph.
methodSources.cannot_support: A predicted material or construction relation is not verified merely because it is plausible, well-ranked, or supported by an LLM explanation; the paper does not validate claims against architectural drawings, field measurements, or Jingning evidence.

methodSources.title: Photogrammetry-based approach for collecting and processing information about an existing building
methodSources.claim: In its single-building study, the UAV photogrammetry model represented geometry visible from outside and could not represent elements or structures not externally visible. Interior elements required a separate BIM model informed by plans and direct measurements. The study also recommends reference checks because individual take-offs could have material error even when an aggregate result looked accurate.
methodSources.read_scope: Read the abstract, UAV/model methods, model-comparison and take-off results, discussion, and conclusions.
methodSources.can_support: An explicit visibility boundary for external UAV oblique imagery and a rationale for independent reference dimensions and separate indoor capture.
methodSources.cannot_support: Internal room geometry, hidden joints/structure, material composition, or historical attributes from external imagery alone; its one-building accuracy figures are not guaranteed for another survey.

methodOptions.deterministic_geometry_baseline: 先固定坐标系、单位与图纸比例；比例未知时先用已知尺寸校准，并保留坐标及来源。两点长度 L=sqrt((dx)^2+(dy)^2)；高差 Δz=z2-z1；坡角 θ=atan2(|Δz|,sqrt((dx)^2+(dy)^2))×180/π，坡度比=|Δz|/水平投影。房间用平面多边形，墙线/柱点/门窗开口作为线或点；用相交、包含关系及正长度共享边界（阈值 ε）生成候选邻接/界面。由坐标公式或几何库计算，再把公式、单位、输入坐标、图纸页码和精度状态写回图谱。
methodOptions.neo4j_and_llm_boundary: Neo4j负责对象与关系约束、路径查询、计数/分组统计；一般多段线和面几何由确定性几何步骤计算后写入图谱。LLM只提议缺失标签/关系候选；把候选、解释、模型与已提供来源分开保存，标记为预测或假设，证据不足时输出unknown/拒答，不自动升级为已证事实。
methodOptions.validation: 对预先设定的虚拟案例真值遮蔽一小部分尺寸/关系/材料标签，保留答案供盲测；长度/坡度与手算坐标基线对照并报绝对误差，关系/标签按precision、recall、F1核对，同时统计无依据断言、冲突和拒答。固定输入与随机种子，确保可复算。此结果只验证合成案例上的流程一致性与预测行为，不构成真实景宁民居的实证验证。
